name: tunahanyazar
description: Claude Code plugins by Tunahan Yazar

plugins.name: prompt-tree
plugins.description: Shows the prompts of a conversation as a tree in a pane, with rewinds and branched sessions as branches and what each turn cost and did.

plugins.name: personal-vault
plugins.description: Ask questions over a local folder of notes. Notes are embedded with a model you host yourself and stored on your machine.

plugins.name: human-code-review
plugins.description: Review a GitHub PR with Claude as the filter: it groups the diff into topics worth a human's judgement, and you read, judge and comment.
